description: An EXTERNAL type declaration, strong or weak (ISO §2023:13.18.22.3 SR1 'in level 1 type declarations'; §2023:13.18.58.3 SR3; §2023:8.5.3; Annex E.3.3 item 20) — a COBOL-2023 addition. §2002:13.14.2 SR5 and §2014:13.16.2 SR5 forbid the EXTERNAL clause in the same data description entry as the REDEFINES, TYPEDEF, or BASED clause, so EXTERNAL with TYPEDEF is refused below 2023 whether or not the TYPEDEF is STRONG; 2023's §2023:13.16.3 SR5 drops TYPEDEF from the list. The strong form is also a 2023 novelty by Annex E.3.3 item 20 ('external items could not be strongly typed'), and SR5 forces a strongly-typed external record's type to itself be an external type declaration. Gated on the co-occurrence of the EXTERNAL clause with a TYPEDEF clause on one data description entry. Below 2023 the external type declaration is rejected.
